speaker: Dokurobey
jp: お前たちよくやったべ
en: You lot did well, y'hear.

speaker: Mujo
jp: あ、ドクロベエ!
en: Ah, Dokurobey!
note: was: あ、ドクロべ, pass 2: あ!ドクロビー!

speaker: Dokurobey
jp: 主役の座の力で我が輩は世界一の主役になり
en: With the power of Top Billing, I'll become the biggest star in the world...

speaker: Dokurobey
jp: 新世界を創造してやるだべ
en: ...and create a new world, y'hear.

speaker: Dokurobey
jp: さあ主役の座を渡すだべ
en: Now, hand over Top Billing, y'hear.

speaker: Mujo
jp: ドクちゃん、これ渡す前に一つ教えてほしいことがあるんだけど
en: Doku-chan, before I hand it over, there's one thing I'd like you to tell me.

speaker: Dokurobey
jp: 色っぽい声でお願いされると我が輩は弱いだべ
en: I can't resist a sultry voice asking nicely, y'hear.

speaker: Dokurobey
jp: なんでも聞くがいいだべ
en: Ask me anything you like, y'hear.

speaker: Mujo
jp: ほんと?
en: Really?

speaker: Mujo
jp: じゃあこの主役の座をどうすると世界一の主役になることができるの?
en: Then what do I do with this Top Billing to become the biggest star in the world?

speaker: Dokurobey
jp: よかよか、教えてやるだべ
en: Fine, fine, I'll tell you, y'hear.

speaker: Dokurobey
jp: その花の中にある主役蜜を飲むんだべ
en: You drink the star nectar inside that flower, y'hear.

speaker: Dokurobey
jp: さすればツヤツヤの玉のような肌になり
en: Do that, and your skin becomes smooth and lustrous as a pearl...

speaker: Dokurobey
jp: その美貌で世界一の主役間違いなしになるのだべ
en: ...and with those looks, you're sure to be the world's biggest star, y'hear.

speaker: Mujo
jp: 玉のようなお肌
en: Skin like a pearl...

speaker: Tobokke
jp: ああ、ムージョ様だけずるい
en: Aw, no fair, Mujo-sama!
note: was: 無茶様だけちゅるい

speaker: Tobokke
jp: 飲ませて飲ませて
en: Let me drink, let me drink!

speaker: Donjuro
jp: わいも飲むまんねや
en: I'll drink some too, I tell ya!

speaker: Zenderman-1
jp: しまった、間に合わなかったか
en: Blast, we're too late!

speaker: Mujo
jp: 美しくなったかしら
en: Have I become beautiful?

speaker: Mujo
jp: なんだいこれ
en: What is this?
note: the three have turned into balls

speaker: Tobokke
jp: もうずいぶん安定が悪くなってしまいましたね
en: We've gotten awfully wobbly.

speaker: Donjuro
jp: まんまるダルマだまんねん
en: We're round as Daruma dolls, I tell ya!
note: ? was: まんまるであるまだまんねや, pass 2: マンマルダーマダマンネン

speaker: Zenderman-1
jp: まるで玉のような姿だな
en: You're round as pearls, the lot of you!

speaker: Tobokke
jp: やい、ドクロベエ、これはどういうことなんだ、ドクロベエ
en: Hey, Dokurobey, what is the meaning of this? Dokurobey!
note: ? both passes: やあ、ドクメ…ドクメ; speaker by the close-up

speaker: Tobokke
jp: あれ、いないもんね
en: Huh? He's gone!

speaker: Dokurobey
jp: 主役蜜が玉のような肌どころか
en: So the star nectar doesn't give you pearly skin...
note: voice only; was: シュアクミス

speaker: Dokurobey
jp: 文字通り玉のような体になることだったとは知らなかっただべ
en: ...it makes you round as a pearl, all over! I had no idea, y'hear.

speaker: Dokurobey
jp: あー、飲まなくてよかった
en: Phew, glad I didn't drink it.
note: ? speaker; pass 2 has the あー

speaker: Mujo
jp: そんな
en: No way...

speaker: Zenderman-1
jp: おいムージョ、その姿よく似合ってるぜ
en: Hey, Mujo, that shape really suits you!

speaker: Zenderman-1
jp: アッハッハッハッハッハ
en: Ahahahahaha!
